description: This Java class 'IntellijProject' builds and manages IntelliJ IDEA project files, including modules, dependencies, and version control mappings, based on a specified repository structure and configuration.

classes.name: IntellijProject
classes.description: Main class responsible for building IntelliJ IDEA project files based on repository structure, modules, and frameworks.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Main method to trigger the project build process, including framework and module setup, and generating project configuration files.

methods.name: createProjectFiles
methods.description: Creates necessary project configuration files and directories for IntelliJ IDEA.

methods.name: buildFrameWorkModule
methods.description: Handles special building procedures for the Android framework module if included.

methods.name: createModulesFile
methods.description: Generates the modules.xml file listing all project modules.

methods.name: createVcsFile
methods.description: Creates vcs.xml associating project directories with version control systems like Git.

methods.name: createNameFile
methods.description: Writes the project name into a .name file.

methods.name: copyTemplates
methods.description: Copies template files from a predefined directory into the project directory.
